named-query.name: User.findXmlByStatus
named-query.query: select u from User u where u.status = :status order by u.updatedAt desc

named-query.name: User.countXmlByStatus
named-query.query: select count(u) from User u where u.status = :status

named-native-query.name: User.findNativeXmlByEmailDomain
named-native-query.query: SELECT id, username, email, status, age, created_at, updated_at FROM users WHERE email LIKE CONCAT('%', ?1) ORDER BY id DESC
